  Portion of [[Team 2]] | publisher = Blizzard Entertainment | date = {{ReleaseDate|WW|November 4, 2026}} | version = | preview = | platforms = {{wp|Microsoft Windows}}, {{wp|macOS}} | genre = [[MMORPG]] | modes = Multiplayer }} '''''World of Warcraft: Forever''''' (referred to by members of the community as '''Classic+''' and internally during development as '''Camelot''') is an upcoming [[Massively multiplayer online game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) developed and published by [[Blizzard Entertainment]]. It was announced at [[BlizzCon 2026]] and will release on 4 November 2026. This [[flavor]] of ''World of Warcraft'' is an alternative version that retains the core mechanics and aesthetic of the game's original 2004 release. However, it distinguishes itself by introducing new storylines, features, and content entirely distinct from the original historical [[timeline]]. It operates as a standalone branch of the MMO, running concurrently with both [[retail]] and [[Classic]] flavors.{{Ref web|url=https://www.polygon.com/world-of-warcraft-forever-announced-classic-plus-blizzcon-2026/|title=Blizzard announces World of Warcraft Forever, the 'Classic Plus' fans have demanded|date=2026-09-12|author=Michael McWhertor|publisher=Polygon}}{{Ref web|url=https://www.invenglobal.com/articles/25888/why-was-world-of-warcraft-forever-created|title=Why Was 'World of Warcraft: Forever' Created?|date=2026-09-12|author=Jaihoon "Laffa" Jeong|publisher=Inven Global}} ''Forever'' is indefinitely{{ref web|url=https://youtube.com/shorts/3fLqbG5LJ1Y|title=WoW: Forever unfolds in original WoW’s year one...|date=2026-09-18|author=Blizzard Entertainment|quote=WoW: Forever begins at the same time original WoW begins. ... We are focused on this year one period of WoW's history, and we intend to occupy this space and expand upon it indefinetely.}} set in the first year of ''World of Warcraft'' (25 [[ADP]]), after the events of the ''[[Forsaken Kingdom]]'' campaign in ''[[Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom]]'' but before the events of ''[[The Burning Crusade]].'' ''Forever'' does not exist in the same continuity as retail ''World of Warcraft''.{{ref web |url=https://www.twitch.tv/blizzard/clip/CrepuscularRespectfulStingrayPogChamp-I3PY2-4UzGGrD7qS |title=WoW Forever continuity discussion - Twitch |accessdate=2026-09-13 |date=2026-09-13 |quote=The short answer is: WoW Forever does not exist in the same contuity as modern World of Warcraft. Metzen likes to call this our little 'time bubble.'}} ''Forever'' has its roots in Classic, drawing on the design philosophies of said game. This means a more grounded storyline, more "crunchy" systems, and an emphasis on community building over auto-matchmaking. However, ''Forever'' will still streamline elements from Classic. Talent trees and specs will be rebalanced, with the intent on making each class viable.{{Ref web|url=https://www.windowscentral.com/gaming/blizzard/we-spoke-to-world-of-warcrafts-ion-hazzikostas-on-forever-vs-retail-horde-vs-alliance-and-more | title=We spoke to World of Warcraft's Ion Hazzikostas on Forever vs. Retail, Horde vs. Alliance, and more — "All versions of WoW should have that."|date=2026-09-18|author=Jez Corden|publisher=Windows Central}} {{OTOC|300}} ==Features== *New zones: [[Mount Hyjal (Forever)|Mount Hyjal]], [[Riverglades]], [[Shen'dralas]], [[Zephras Isle]] **[[Forever map comparison|Expanded original zones]] **[[Dalaran]] in the [[Alterac Mountains]] **Updated world visuals *New lighting and global illumination, volumetric fog and god rays, improved water graphics and shadows. *New [[#Dungeons and raids|dungeons and raids]]{{ref web|url=https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/krol%E2%80%99dok-stronghold/628618|author=Kaivax|date=2026-09-14|title=Krol'dok Stronghold|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260917003529/https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/krol%E2%80%99dok-stronghold/628618/1}} *New [[#Class abilities and talents|skills and talents]] *New [[#Race class combinations|race and class combinations]] *New playable race: [[Skyborne]] *New [[#Camping|camping]] and [[#Legacy|Legacy]] systems *New battleground: [[Darkspear Islands (battleground)|Darkspear Islands]] *Account-wide [[Collections]] (with new transmog, [[Forever mounts|mounts]], and [[Forever companions|companions]]) *Over 1,000 [[Forever campaign|new quests]] *New items, rewards, and [[#Tradeskills|tradeskills]] content *SD/HD [[Character]] model toggle *[[Level cap]] at 60, indefinitely *First and last names *Players are split up by ruleset ([[PvE|Normal]]/[[PvP]]/[[RP]]/[[RP-PvP]]/[[Hardcore]]) on one "mega-[[realm]]" per ruleset per region **Hardcore will be available at a later date ==Launch timeline== [[File:September 2026 Roadmap - Forever.jpg|thumb|Forever roadmap from September 2026]] As announced at BlizzCon 2026, Blizzard posted a [[roadmap]] with scheduled dates. All dates and times in this section are presented in your browser's time zone. {{countdown|time=2026-11-04 23:00|intro=Forever launches in...}} ;September 17: Beta, until {{time|date=2026-10-23|start=17:00}}{{ref web|url=https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/heads-up-wow-forever-stress-test-on-october-21/2387920|date=2026-10-20|author=Kaivax|title=Heads Up – WoW Forever Stress Test on October 21}} ;October 21: Stress test, from {{time|date=2026-10-21|start=21:00|end=25:00}} ;October 27: Early name reservation, starting {{time|date=2026-10-27|start=20:00}}, up to three reserved characters per account{{ref web|url=https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24303866/claim-your-world-of-warcraft-forever-character-names|title=Claim Your World of Warcraft: Forever Character Names|author=Blizzard Entertainment|date=2026-10-20}} ;November 4: Launch, at {{time|date=2026-11-05|start=0:00}} ;December 9: Raids unlock: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, Onyxia's Lair ;Winter 2026/2027: Hardcore mode launches ;Spring 2027: 2 new raids, 2 new dungeons, new quests and playable area, new legendary questline, PvP season refresh ;Summer 2027: Revamped iconic raid, new raid, expanded world content, 2 new dungeons, PvP season refresh, professions and legacy updates ==Races and classes== ===Race class combinations=== The six new [[playable race]] combinations for old races (when compared to classic) are marked with the {{Forever-inline}} icon. ==New and updated systems== ===Legacy=== [[File:Legacy Trees.jpg|thumb|Legacy Trees]] {{main|Legacy System}} The Legacy System is the ''Forever'' version of [[achievements]], and instead of just earning achievement points that can't be traded for anything, completing [[Legacy Challenges]] like leveling a class to levels 25, 40, and 60 award Legacy Points that can be used in skill trees that improve the leveling experience for alts or tradeskills. Points are earned account-wide, but each character can ''individually'' fill out their own trees and respec the trees as necessary at class trainers, so if one character is already maxed out and doesn't need any help with leveling, that character can spend points on tradeskill buffs instead. There are 65 total Legacy Points available with the launch of ''Forever'', and players earn account-wide rewards at point thresholds: {| class="darktable zebra" |+ Legacy Rewards |- ! Points !! Reward !! Type |- ! 15 | [[Holstered Replica Ironforge Air Rifle]] || Toy |- ! 25 | [[Spectral Bear Cub]] || Companion |- ! 40 | [[Spectral Bear Tabard]] || Tabard |- ! 55 | [[Reins of the Spectral Bear]] || Mount |} ===Camping=== [[File:Camping.jpg|thumb|Camping]] {{main|Camping}} Camping is a new system in ''Forever'', building on the [[Cooking Fire (ability)|Cooking Fire]] used in cooking. The intent is that players set up a campfire and hang out for a bit, as other adventurers come by and apply their tradeskill buffs, hopefully making connections (and maybe even friends) with other players. Unlock camping at roughly level 5 by finding an adventurer outside the starting zone's major quest hub and complete a few quests like [[The Great Outdoors (Forever)]]. All tradeskills provide upgradable utility when used while camping, starting at skill level 20. The buffs provided while camping do not stack with the equivalent class abilities, so the [[First Aid Kit]] crafted with [[First Aid]] won't stack with a priest's [[Power Word: Fortitude#Forever]]. High-end versions of tradeskill camping abilities drop from dungeons and raids, and can provide [[crafting station]]s that are required for high-end crafting abilities. ===Tradeskills=== Each tradeskill in ''Forever'' has dozens of new and updated recipes, many of which are acquired from the [[Azeroth Commerce Authority]] or [[Durotar Supply and Logistics]], which return from {{g|sod}}. High-end recipes both cost [[Merchant's Favor]] and have a reputation requirement. Just like in ''Season of Discovery'', loot crates from around the world, fill them, then take them to either faction's camp to trade them for reputation and Merchant's Favor. The Azeroth Commerce Authority's camp is located at {{co|10|73|Redridge Mountains (Forever)}} at [[Three Corners]] in the {{c|Redridge Mountains}}. Durotar Supply and Logistics is located at {{co|42|34|Barrens (Forever)}} west of the [[Crossroads]] in the {{c|Barrens}}. Leveling the six primary non-gathering tradeskills awards Legacy Points for the [[Legacy System]], and there's a [[Legacy Tree]] devoted to tradeskills, with perks like [[Working Overtime (legacy talent)]], which increases the chance to gain a skill point by 4-20%, and [[Dedicated Study]], a daily-cooldown ability that raises the lowest learned tradeskill by one point. Some notable changes include moving basic healing potions from Alchemy to First Aid (like the [[Minor Healing Potion]]), tailors have many new Bind on Pickup patterns, the tauren's [[Cultivation#Forever]] racial ability will duplicate herb nodes, and so on. ==''Season of Discovery'' carryovers== A few previously {{g|sod}}-only features have been carried over to ''Forever''. ===Cozy Sleeping Bag=== [[File:Cozy Sleeping Bag.jpg|thumb|Cozy Sleeping Bag]] The [[Cozy Sleeping Bag]] provides a stacking experience buff and also serves as a portable [[rest]] area, allowing players to gain rested experience while not logged in. Complete a scavenger hunt starting at level 14 in either {{c|Westfall}} or {{c|Barrens|the Barrens}} with [[...and that note you found]] to pick up the bag. ===Chronoboon Displacer=== The [[Chronoboon Displacer]] is also available, but it is only useful in the open world, as [[world buff]]s are removed inside dungeons and raids. ===Library books=== Previously a mage-only endeavor, [[library book]]s are available for all classes in ''Forever''. Turn in 10, 20, and 25 books to [[Garion Wendell]] inside the [[Wizard's Sanctum]] of [[Stormwind City]], or [[Owen Thadd]] in the [[Magic Quarter]] of [[Undercity]] to pick up quests with unique rewards: # 10 - [[Friend of the Library]] - [[Scholarly Pendant]] or [[Erudite's Amulet]] # 20 - [[Greater Friend of the Library]] - [[Field Researcher's Loop]] or [[Philanthropist's Ring]] # 25 - [[Greater Friend of the Library (2)]] - [[Truthseeker's Bow]], [[Crest of Elucidation]], or [[Researcher's Nightlight]] Mages who turn in at least one book learn [[Study]], which gives a bundle of solved comprehension scrolls on an hourly cooldown when used at a turn-in location. ===Comprehension scrolls=== The [[Comprehension Charm]] from ''SoD'' is now the mage [[Comprehend Scroll]] ability. Use it on scrolls that drop in the world like [[Scroll: LOWER PING WHOMEVER]] to turn them into standard stat scrolls like [[Scroll of Intellect]]. Higher-skill scrolls can turn into interesting cantrips like [[Scroll of Liminal Passage]], and even higher-skill scrolls can turn into the [[Scroll of the Blade]], which can transform a [[Hypnotic Blade#Classic]] to a [[Narpas Sword#Forever]]. ==Editions== [[File:Skyborne Epic Pack.png|thumb|Skyborne Epic Pack contents]] ''World of Warcraft: Forever'' can be played in full by having [[game time]] on the [[account]]; no additional purchase is necessary (with the exception of the [[Skyborne]] race). The [[Skyborne Heroic Pack]] and [[Skyborne Epic Pack]] are optional editions that provide access to the [[Skyborne]] and the [[Zephras Isle]] starting experience, as well as vanity goodies in both Forever and [[retail]].{{Ref web|url=https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301508/pre-purchase-world-of-warcraft-forever-upgrades-and-begin-your-next-journey-in-azeroth|title=Pre-Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades and Begin Your Next Journey in Azeroth|publisher=Blizzard Entertainment|date=2026-09-12}} The following vanity goodies are available in the packs: ;''Forever''-only *[[Skyborne]] race + [[Zephras Isle]] starting experience *[[Lordaeron Forever]] and [[Shen'dorei Tabard]] *[[Zergling Leash#Forever HD]], [[Panda Collar#Forever HD]], [[Diablo Stone#Forever HD]], and [[Pachimari]] pets ;Retail-only *Skyborne housing decor ([[Handmade Shen'dorei Pillow]], [[Shen'dorei Standard]], [[Windshaper's Chimes]], [[Windwell]], [[Zephras Drapery]]) ;Both *[[Cerulean Prideclaw]] (ground mount) *[[Ensemble: Shen'dorei Skyseer's Garb]] (transmog set) *[[Veteran Adventurer's Rucksack]] (transmog) *[[Shen'dorei Windwell]] (toy) *[[Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion]] (ground mount) *[[Ensemble: Veteran Adventurer's Outdoor Wear]] (transmog set) The [[Warcraft Forever Collection]] is also available for a limited time that provides everything listed above, the full ''[[Warcraft III: Reforged]]'' game, ''[[Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom]]'', and Forsaken and Human figurines [[housing decor]] in [[retail]] ([[Boardcraft Forsaken Figurine]], [[Boardcraft Human Figurine]]). ==Tie-in literature== *''[[Unbowed]]'' (short story) ==Development== The idea of what became ''Forever'' originated after the launch of Classic, when it was noted that a group of players didn't want to move on to ''[[The Burning Crusade]]'', but instead wanted to have new experiences at level 60. Eventually, Blizzard used [[Season of Discovery]] as an experiment to explore the limits of that idea.{{Ref web|url=https://wccftech.com/world-of-warcraft-forever-blizzcon-2026-release-date/|title=World of Warcraft: Forever Is Blizzard’s Third Version of WoW, Launching November 4 After Years of Groundwork|publisher=WCCF Tech|date=2026-09-13}} When development began on ''Forever'', the four following pillars were used: *'''Approachable and familiar''': Every addition is measured against the spirit of the original rather than against novelty. No flying mounts, no level scaling, [[Azeroth]] remains dangerous; challenge comes from preparation and cooperation rather than arbitrary difficulty. *'''The world is the main character''': New zones, quests, and rewards across all levels of play. Not every story has to be about saving the world. *'''Journey before destination''': No level cap increases; players can only catch up through levelling. *'''Protect and nurture social experiences''': Systems are designed with the understanding that quality-of-life concessions can affect how players interact with each other. The idea of a "WoW Mythos" was looked at when developing ''Forever''. The "mythos" in question was the unfinished content of the original ''World of Warcraft''; elements such as raids, dungeons, zones, battlegrounds, incomplete storylines, unused characters, etc.{{Ref web|url=https://warcraft.blizzplanet.com/pax-2026-world-of-warcraft-forever-panel-transcript/3/|title=PAX 2026 World of Warcraft: Forever Panel Transcript|publisher=Blizzplanet|date=2026-10-11}} The level journey of 1–60 was important to retain, due to it only being found in Classic. Another focus was to retain the traditional ''World of Warcraft'' art style.{{Ref web|url=https://warcraft.blizzplanet.com/pax-2026-world-of-warcraft-forever-panel-transcript/4/|title=PAX 2026 World of Warcraft: Forever Panel Transcript|publisher=Blizzplanet|date=2026-10-11}} ==End of beta event== [[File:Forever end of beta event.jpg|thumb|Kazzak destroying Brill]] At 10 AM PDT on October 22, the [[end of beta event]] started, continuing the tradition since the original beta back in 2004. All creatures started dropping BoE [[Molten Core]] loot with no level requirement, like [[Tier 1]] armor and weapons like [[Shadowstrike (polearm)#Classic]] as well as special elixirs and scrolls. Out in the world, high-level [[Infernal (beta)|Infernals]] appeared as well. {{columns|3| *[[Elixir of Endless Experience]] *[[Elixir of Endless Growth]] *[[Elixir of Endless Healing]] *[[Elixir of Endless Intellect]] *[[Elixir of Endless Mana]] *[[Elixir of Endless Opportunity]] *[[Elixir of Endless Power]] *[[Elixir of Endless Rapidity]] *[[Scroll of Endless Fortitude]] *[[Scroll of Endless Speed]] }} In quest hubs like [[Brill]] and [[Goldshire]] as well as outside of capital cities, [[Azuregos (tactics)|Azuregos]], [[Lord Kazzak (tactics)|Lord Kazzak]], [[Super Hogger]], [[Thunderaan]], and [[Voracious (abomination)|Voracious]] were attacking. Bosses were dropping [[Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros#Classic]], [[Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker#Classic]], [[Benediction]], [[Quel'Serrar]], [[Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers]], and other powerful weapons. Appearing at most quest hubs and outside of cities, [[Gabbi Goodwhistle]] sells a few elixirs and is also a weapon trainer. At around 5 PM PDT, [[Conspicuous Crate]]s and [[Plague Zombie]]s from the [[Scourge Invasion]] started spawning.
